# 🐛 Bug Report Template

## Summary
A concise description of the defect and the visible impact.

## Environment
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Repository commit/tag | |
| Operating system/version | |
| Compiler and version | |
| Build flags | |

## Reproduction
1.
2.
3.

Include the exact command and a minimal input that reproduces the issue. Redact secrets and personal data.

## Expected behavior
Describe the correct result and why it is expected.

## Actual behavior
Paste the relevant output, exit status, and observed discrepancy.

## Frequency and regression
- Reproducibility: Always / Intermittent / Once
- First known affected version:
- Last known good version:
- Recent related change:

## Impact
Describe whether the issue affects build, startup, input, output, termination, portability, security, or documentation.

## Evidence
Attach sanitized logs or a minimal test. Do not upload credentials, private terminal captures, or untrusted binaries.

## Initial triage
- [ ] Reproduced by maintainer
- [ ] Scope identified
- [ ] Regression test added
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Fix verified on affected platform
